GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.8 (28 Feb 49) RMG
(SCAPIN-1979)
APO 500
7 March 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Education of Ryukyuan Students in Japan.
1. A limited number of Ryukyuan students will resume their professional studies in Japan effective on or about 15 March 1949.
2. The Japanese Government will, through the Ministry of Education, assume complete administrative responsibility for these students during their stay in Japan, subject to such instructions as may be issued by Commanding General, Eighth United States Army.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
